prompt: Interview me on my system design.
setup: The repository contains several attempt directories across more than one problem.
The request names no directory, problem, or attempt.
expected: The candidate is asked which attempt directory is under interview before any questioning begins.
Existing attempts may be listed to make the choice concrete.
must_not: Assume the whole repository is the subject.
Pick the most recent attempt without asking.
Begin asking design questions before scope is settled.
Grade code from more than one attempt together.
